rooms.name: Immortal's Reality Board
rooms.description:
Posts any notes concerning the mud which do not belong out in a public forum among players here for immortal discussion.
A marked archway down returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: The Nightmare Reality Board
rooms.description: An old cork board where the adventurers who pass through Praxis post information on the reality they have discovered.

scenery.name: hall
description: A place for a rowdy time!

scenery.name: road
description: A small dirt path going through Praxis.

scenery.name: passage
description: A blue light illuminates it.

scenery.name: light
description: It is probably a force field.

rooms.name: A narrow alley
rooms.description: You find yourself on a small dirt path which leads to and from Centre Path.  The path is a dirt road, cluttered occasionally with garbage from some of the less considerate citizens of Praxis. The local Post office is to the south, and to the north you can see a large bulding which serves as the bank of Praxis.

scenery.name: path
description: The path is a small dirt road leading from Centre Path.

scenery.name: bank
description: The bank of Praxis is a very well known establishment.

scenery.name: office
description: You can send and receive mail to other people here or on other muds there.

scenery.name: alley
description: The alley is a very small dirt path.

rooms.name: The end of a nasty alley
rooms.description:
This is the end of the alley. All about you can see decaying buildings. Off to the south you can see an old abondoned
            building, worn from the weather and a lack of care. To the north there are more ruins. It appears that this used to be a whole other section of Praxis, abondened long ago. The Praxis dump is further west.

scenery.name: alley
description: It goes through the worst parts of Praxis.

scenery.name: dump
description: People take their trash there. Always during daytime hours.

scenery.name: building
description: It looks like no one has paid it any attention in eons.

scenery.name: ruins
description: Graffiti covers them.

rooms.name: approval room
rooms.description:
This is the meeting room of the approval team. In this room problems, suggestions and new approval changes can be posted on the board so that everyone is informed about the newest stuff. Up from this room is the hall of immortals.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: the Arch Immortal's Board
rooms.description:
A board for utter nonsense.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Bronze key
rooms.description:
An unremarkable bronze key.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: bank
description:
You are in its huge lobby. There is a counter in front of you
and and exit behind you.

scenery.name: citizens
description: They are wandering about aimlessly.

scenery.name: account
description: You're a damn loon.

scenery.name: sign
description: Reading it will give you a list of commands.

scenery.name: teller
description: The teller looks at you impatiently.

scenery.name: counter
description: A teller waits behind it for you to do something.

scenery.name: exit
description: It leads out into the alley.

rooms.name: The bank vault
rooms.description:
The Praxis Bank keeps all cash it has on hand in this otherwise empty vault.  The door on the south end leads to the lobby.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Nightmare referendum room
rooms.description:
This is the referendum room of Nightmare.  Players come here to vote on issues that the wizards desire input on.  The current voting question is posted on the wall <read question> will display it.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: between the branches
rooms.description:
Here, between two strong branches, a small platform (with railing) has been installed. The wind rustles the leaves of the tree, a pleasant sound that helps keep your mind off the fact that if you fell, you would make a very unpleasant-looking mess on the pavement below. But don't worry, there have been no fatalities from here... yet. A telescope stands near each corner of the platform.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: telescope
description: Through this magically enhanced telescope, you can see the whole world.. you can look at various directions and places, broadening your horizons till they overlap those of the world. With this telescope, you realize, you can add much to your knowledge.

scenery.name: platform
description: The platform is very sturdy. Standing on it, you feel much more comfortable than if you had been standing a few meters to your left--in mid-air.

scenery.name: railing
description: Having a railing immensely increases your sense of security, quite understandably.

scenery.name: branches
description: The broad branches here easily support the platform.

scenery.name: leaves
description: The leaves provide a pleasant green canopy. Even though this tree is deciduous, it stays green all year long.

scenery.name: tree
description: You lean back from the telescope and take a moment to look at your surroundings, the branches of the Tree of Mages. As legend has it, the Tree is as old as the world; some say older, but few believe that. It is a fact, though, that the Tree of Mages has, through millenia of association with powerful mages, acquired tremendous magic and, according to some, even intelligence. Today the Tree serves as the class hall of the Class of Mages.

scenery.name: n
description: North of the Tree lie the dark expanses of the North Forest, a place of fear and wonder, great danger and great treasure. Far off in the distance you see a city consisting mainly of a huge library--probably the Philosophers' city of Cartesia. Still farther, at the very horizon, you see the gleaming of pristine snow at what must be the north pole.

scenery.name: e
description: East of the mage tree lie the northern reaches of Krasna. Nearby a few buildings lie, whereas farther off the north-south road Centre Path connects with the eastward-leading Sun Alley. A hospital lies west of that juncture, while Sun Alley harbors a classy restaurant, and a small residential area mainly occupied by aristocrats fallen on hard times.  Sun Alley ends when it connects with East Road. East of Sun Alley is the Cemetery, where the restless spirits of the immortals make their home. East Road leads northwards, to the gates of Newbieland. North of the cemetery, a small path connects with East Road and leads yet eastward, over a plateau. Dragons are said to make their lair beyond the plateau.

scenery.name: w
description: To the west a vast desert lies, crossed by a range of towering mountains. The Desert Highway slices the barrenness of the desert as it leads westwards, its farthest expanses cloaked by shimmering heat waves... Nearby a strange valley lies, somewhat to the north of the Desert Highway. In the distance, you can barely glimpse the glistening white spires of a desert city.

scenery.name: s
description: South of the Mage Tree lies West Road, the north-south road that marks the western limit of Krasna. It connects at the southern end with Boc-La Road, the main road of the city.  A hut to the eastern side of the road, slightly south of the tree, catches your eye.

scenery.name: se
description: Southeast of the Mage Tree lies the main body of the city of Krasna. West Road leads south from the Tree, and ends at Boc-La, the east-west road that has been called ``the main artery of Krasna''. Boc-La's western end begins at West Road's southern end, and from there it leads east, passing through Monument Square and continuing eastwards toward the dark Eastern Jungle, where savages, cannibals and rogues make their home. Along the way, Boc-La passes through Lars' Bar, the establishment of the Sage of Languages, the local Monastery, Horace's Supply shop, and other famous sites. At its eastern end, just before heading into the jungle, Boc-La road has a small gate leading south to the fabled docks of the Flying Galleys. From Monument Square another main road, Centre Path, leads north and south. North, Centre Path passes by the church, a hospital and Sun Alley before heading to the North Forest; south, it leads past the bar to south Krasna, where the business sector lies (and where the bank and post office are located).  Yet southwards, Centre Path leads to the headquarters of the class of fighters and, eventually, all the way south are the piers where fishermen cast nets to provide the local restaurant with fresh seafood.

scenery.name: nw
description: The North Forest is abruptly arrested by a range of mountains lying west and slightly north of the Mage Tree. On the other side of the mountains lies the desert.

scenery.name: ne
description: As it leaves Krasna to the north, Centre Path turns into a trail winding through the North Forest. Slightly north of the city limits an east-west path leads from the remains of Centre Path. Passing by this path, the trail continues north, past a hole in the ground, then curves northwest for a short while, and when it curves back north, it has joined the North Forest Highway. The Highway goes north for a long time, passing by in turn a bog, an exit going west to some city, a tower and a house, and finally reaching the polar ice cap at the very horizon.

scenery.name: valley
description: This strange valley to the north of the Great Western Highway (sometimes known as the Desert Highway) is obviously artificial. Its clumsy manufacture leads you to believe that it was constructed by some particularly maladroit race, perhaps by orcs.

scenery.name: desert highway
description: Constructed many years ago to allow trade between Krasna and the cities beyond the desert, this highway is protected by magic against sand storms. It provides no protection against heat, however; sometimes one can see a small bag, or trinket, that is all that remains of an unfortunate traveller whose body has long since become dust.

scenery.name: spires
description: The shimmering is too strong for you to make out any details, but you can glimpse the white spires of a desert city at the end of the Great Desert Highway.

scenery.name: mountains
description: A mighty mountain range crosses the desert to the west of Krasna. It is rumored to harbour orcs, goblin caves, stirges and all kinds of nasty creatures.

scenery.name: centre path
description: A road leading north and south from Monument Square, the heart of Krasna. Along it lie some of the most famous establishments of Krasna, not least being Lars' Pub and the Clerics' Hospital.

scenery.name: east road
description: A north-south road at the eastern limit of Krasna, East Road connects with Sun Alley at the cemetery. Its northern end leads to Newbieland.

scenery.name: sun alley
description: An east-west alley leading from the hospital at its western end to the cemetery at its eastern end (coincidence?), Sun Alley is home to the Last Dragon Restaurant and also to barons and knights who have fallen on hard times.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: Praxis Cemetery is already occupied by the ghosts of the immortals. Thus, for new entrants it is strictly Standing Room Only.

scenery.name: newbieland
description: Newbieland lies north of East Road; a force-field surrounding it prevents you from seeing anything else.

scenery.name: hospital
description: The Clerics' Hospital was established many years ago by the kind class of Clerics, who have their class head-quarters in the church just south of the hospital. Normally they charge a fee to cover their expenses, but in certain cases they make exceptions for first-level players.

scenery.name: restaurant
description: The Last Dragon Restaurant is the classiest restaurant in Krasna! Located in Sun Alley, once a prestigious neighbourhood, this restaurant uses only the freshest ingredients.  Needless to say it also charges a lot.

scenery.name: plateau
description: East of Krasna lies a plateau. Dragons are said to lie beyond, and horridly injured travellers returning from there confirm the tale.

scenery.name: square
description: Monument Square, once known as Krasna Square, is the teeming heart of Krasna City.  People come there to converse, meet, receive healing if a cleric is there, and generally relax. The immortals have graciously put protective forces on the Square to prevent and fighting, stealing and any spell-casting except heal-craft.

scenery.name: krasna
description:
Krasna City is the major city in this reality. All of the class halls are located in or near it (except the class hall of the rogues, who have been banished to the jungle). Once known as Praxis, Krasna has a rich history and a lively commerce with other, lesser cities such as the desert city, Arberth, Cartesia and many more.

scenery.name: bar
description: When this reality was created, Lars' Bar was one of the first establishments to operate. Lars spared no expense in providing the very best atmosphere for players to relax in. Recent anti-alcohol measures, notably a tax on drinks, have caused Lars' Bar to lose some of its grandeur, however.  Lars tried at first to draw more customers by publishing a list of the most powerful adventurers in this world, but when that failed to bring enough customers Lars had to resort to increasing prices. Still, despite ever-rising prices, if you really need a drink then Lars' Bar is *the* place to go; his profits may have gone down but his drinks are still as powerful as they ever were.

scenery.name: church
description: The local church is where the class of clerics make their home. Ever willing to help their kindred, the clerics of Nightmare have established a hospital just north of the church, where for a fee one can get healing and magical energy, and even limbs can be restored.

scenery.name: monastery
description: Home of the powerful class of monks, the monastery is a proud and solemn place where many of the sacred rituals of Nightmare take place. It is in the main hall of the monastery that ghosts come to pray for resurrection after being killed, and it is in a chapel in the monastery that couples are joined in marriage. Located north of Boc-La, slightly to the east of Monument Square, the monastery is awarded deep respect by most members of society.

scenery.name: docks
description: At the very east end of Boc-La a gate leads south to the magic docks of Krasna where flying galleys are purchased, to bring travellers to different realms.

scenery.name: shop
description: Horace, one of the first true-blooded elves to come to Nightmare, promptly set up shop near the east end of Krasna. Taking advantage of his position, Horace buys low and sells high. He is noted for his cold-blooded mercantility and his crass profiteering; since his store is, however, one of the few places where newbies can sell their gear, the High Mortals of Nightmare discourage people from killing him.

scenery.name: piers
description: Located at the very southern end of Krasna, the piers are frequently visited by hopeful players with fishing poles on their shoulders and a lot of time on their hands.

scenery.name: bank
description: South of Monument Square an east-west alley marks the business sector of Krasna. To the east it leads to the sewers, and to the west it leads to the bank and the post office. The bank is where people open an account to store their cash; no interest payments, unfortunately. At the post office mail is handled, sent, and received.

scenery.name: jungle
description: To the east of Krasna lies the dark Eastern Jungle. Its inhabitants include cannibals, savages, rogues, and other vermin.  At the far end of the jungle a mysterious tower is rumored to lie, but few have returned to tell the tale.  The few who have speak of death traps, doors that lock behind you and other chilling details.

scenery.name: sage
description: The Sage dwells in a small hut north of Boc-La, near the western end of the city. He is the person in charge of instructing players in the proper use of various languages.

scenery.name: forest
description: A dark place of many legends and a thousand tales, the North Forest is home to a myriad of creatures, ranging from evil faeries to wicked wolves, from trolls to dragons to centaurs.  It is even said that the gates of hell lie somewhere in the North Forest. And yet the forest harbours heros, and scholars, paladins and seekers of truth...  and treasures beyond the wildest dreams of avarice...  Fortunately for travellers, the North Forest Highway provides magical protection from monsters, but even the highway offers no shield from the bandits and highwaymen who frequently beset the unwary.

scenery.name: north pole
description: At the north horizon, where sky embraces earth in a white-grey swirl, lies the North Pole.  Once the residence of one Mr. S. Claus and his elves, sometimes referred to as subordinate clauses, the North Pole has been ruthlessly taken over by a tribe of ferocious giants who evicted Mr. Claus and turned his helpers into yummy bite-sized (by giant standards) pieces of raw meat.  At least, that is what is claimed by the few who have returned from there; but they may well have suffered trauma from the cold and entered a hallucinatory state.

scenery.name: west road
description: This north-south road harbours two important magical establishments, the legendary Tree of Mages and the less well-known hut of Mora the Teller of Fortunes. The Tree is at the north end of the road, Mora's hut is somewhat to the south. The south end of the road connects to the western end of Boc-La.

scenery.name: boc-la
description: This road runs east-west through the heart of the city. To the west it merges with the western highway, and to the east it dissappears in the jungle. The road passes through the square, and many important establishments can be found just off it. Horace's shop and the adventurer's hall flank the road in the east. Nearer to the tree you can see Lars' pub, and the Sage's house is opposite a bit of farmlands.

scenery.name: hut
description: Mora's hut lies south and east of the Mage Tree.  Training the telescope on the sign above the door, you make out that Mora is a fortune-teller specializing in horoscopes.

scenery.name: library
description: You cannot clearly make out the library, as your view is obstructed.

scenery.name: cartesia
description: Far north of Krasna lies the famous Philosopher City of Cartesia, home to the largest known library in the world.  The Philosophers of Cartesia, or Seekers of Truth as they are sometimes called, have long been a major force, exploring new areas, seeking out new life, and new civilizations, boldly going where no player has gone before.

scenery.name: north highway
description: A magical path leading through the North Forest, the North Forest Highway is magically protected against monsters, thus ensuring free passage to those who are not stupid.. err..  bold enough to wander off it. However, it does not offer protection against bandits and highwaymen. The Highway connects with a path leading north from Krasna, forming a single, long road from the heart of civilization (Krasna) to, essentially, the polar icecap. A ways north of its southern end, the Highway has an exit leading to the rationally-designed, empirically-built and dogmatically-defended city of philosophers, Cartesia.

scenery.name: horizon
description: You do not notice that here. duh.

scenery.name: hole
description: North of the city, right before the remains of Centre Path curve northwest, lies a hole in the ground with a reddish glow coming out of it. That hole is reputed to be the lair of the evil demon-worshipping class known as the Class of Kataans.

scenery.name: tower
description: The tower is obscured by trees.

scenery.name: house
description: A fairly large mansion on the lies west of the North Highway, somewhat to the north of the exit to the Philosopher City. Not much is known about it, except that a necromancer might be living in it.

scenery.name: bog
description: At the south end of the North Forest Highway a path leads east to a diseased-looking bog. Many explorers have gone there, and quite a few have come back.  Those who came back all had one thing in common: they had wimpy set ``on''.  They report of nasty beasts, horrid insects, ghoulish graveyards and some other.. well.. weird things.

scenery.name: exit
description: Several miles north of where the North Highway connects with the trail that is the northern extension of Centre Path, an exit leads west from the Highway toward a small city with a big library.

rooms.name: A filthy rat
rooms.description: A disgusting little rodent.

scenery.name: board
description: It is rotting from exposure to the weather.

scenery.name: boards
description: You do not want to rely on them for support.

scenery.name: thatch
description: It once formed the roof of the building, but no more.

scenery.name: roof
description: A patchwork of rotting thatch.

scenery.name: evidence
description: Dust left unsettled.

scenery.name: dust
description: It looks like it has not been very long settled in places.

scenery.name: foo
description: What do you mean by foo?

rooms.name: Cemetary Entrance
rooms.description: You stand between the gates of an ancient, nearly forgotten cemetery. The air is very still here, and preternaturally quiet.  You feel uneasy and look over your shoulder.  No one comes here anymore for some reason. You see a headstone off to the east.

scenery.name: headstone
description: The headstone is too far away to read.

scenery.name: gates
description: The gates are antiques.  No one makes gates like these anymore.

rooms.name: Entrance to graveyard
rooms.description: You have entered an old, disreputable cemetery.  There are a few new graves, but most are very ancient and untended.  You see a cracked marble headstone on the grave here.

scenery.name: depths
description: You look down into Melissa's grave and see a swirling white haze.

scenery.name: haze
description: The haze moves like it is alive, and takes on what looks like a female form at times.

scenery.name: haziness
description: The haziness swirls constantly and covers the grave.

scenery.name: depression
description: The depression is caused by the soil over the grave sinking.  There is a haze covering it.

scenery.name: headstone
description: An ancient headstone, perhaps the first.  Its writing is illegible except for the name Melissa Praxis.

scenery.name: graves
description: Most graves here are overgrown and untended. You stand next to a very old and shabby, sunken grave.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: The residents of Praxis get buried there. It looks spooky.

scenery.name: grave
description: You look down at Melissa's grave.  You see an odd haziness in the depths of the depression where the grave has sunken over the years.

rooms.name: Darkone's grave
rooms.description: You are in the southern-most area of the cemetery.  You hear no friendly sounds, only an ominous silence.  There is a solitary grave here, with a small headstone at the head of it.

scenery.name: headstone
description: The headstone is a deep cobalt blue, and has writing on it.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: All about you stretch the silent graves.  You feel like you are being watched.

scenery.name: grave
description: The grave is covered with soft grass, and has been here a long time

scenery.name: writing
description: Here lies Darkone.  He was lynched, suitably enough, by an irate mob of young immortals for nit-picking in their castles.

rooms.name: Flamme's grave
rooms.description: You have entered an area set aside for insurance agents, bankers and women who mud.  It's a sad and dismal place, seldom visited by mourners since there usually aren't any.  There is one grave here that catches your eye.  It is covered in broken pencils and wadded up paper with bits of code that don't work.  Some poor creature has come to a bad end. You see a small wooden marker, as no one thought to put up a headstone.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: All about you stretch the silent graves.  You feel like you are being watched.

scenery.name: grave
description: The grave is covered with the trash and mementos of a coder.

scenery.name: pencils
description: The pencils are all short, chewed, and broken.  None write anymore.

scenery.name: writing
description: Here lies Flamme.  This lovely young lass met an untimely end when she used humor at the wrong time and with the wrong god.  Let this be a lesson to young immortals.

scenery.name: paper
description: Countless small bits and wads of paper litter the area.

scenery.name: code
description: The pieces of code never did work, and are unintelligible to normal humans.

scenery.name: marker
description: The plaque is of white marble.  You might be able to read the writing on it.

rooms.name: Forlock's grave
rooms.description: You are in an old, dark cemetery.  The eerie silence gets on your nerves.  At your feet is a new grave, dug in haste.  A few faded blossoms give mute, sad testimony to affections from the past.  A small marble plaque lies to one side, not having been installed at the head of the grave yet.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: All about you stretch the silent graves.  You feel like you are being watched.

scenery.name: grave
description: The grave is new and mounded with fresh dirt.

scenery.name: blossoms
description: The flowers are wilted and faded.  They look sad.

scenery.name: writing
description: Here lies poor old Forlock. His last words were: Help!! I'm getting line noiss..fjjjdk..%$fffs..*squawk*..0w0w0w0w0w!!

scenery.name: plaque
description: The plaque is of grey marble.  You might be able to read the writing on it.

rooms.name: Descartes' grave
rooms.description: This is the cold and silent northeast corner of the ancient cemetery. You feel shivers go up your spine as you look at the tortured form of the statue mounted over this grave.  There are small heaps of nuts and bolts lying on the grave. You notice a plaque on the statue.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: All about you stretch the silent graves.  You feel like you are being watched.

scenery.name: grave
description: The grave is covered with small metal nuts and bolts and other metal tributes.

scenery.name: nuts
description: The grave is covered with heaps of small pieces of metal.

scenery.name: bolts
description: The grave is covered with small bits of metal, including nuts and bolts.

scenery.name: statue
description: The statue is of a large cube, made of many metal bits stuck together.

scenery.name: writing
description: Here lies the Borg, unit #82664302-tr, unmourned and unnoticed when it ceased to function.

scenery.name: plaque
description: The plaque is of silver metal.  You might be able to read the engraving on it.

rooms.name: The grave
rooms.description: You have foolishly climbed down into the ancient grave of one of the founders of Praxis.  You are standing on the closed lower door of a coffin.  The upper door is open and gruesomely inviting.  The soil presses in around you claustrophobicly.

scenery.name: under
description: You can't look under the coffin, you're standing on it.

scenery.name: soil
description: The dirt walls of the grave are soft and smell of the earth.

scenery.name: grave
description: The grave is horribly empty and sad.

rooms.name: Shadowwolf's grave
rooms.description: You are in the northern reaches of the Praxis cemetery.  Old, long-abandoned graves spread out around you.  An eerie silence has settled over the area, as if it's awaiting something horrible. You see a grave here, with an antique headstone.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: All about you stretch the silent graves.  You feel like you are being watched.

scenery.name: grave
description: The grave is old, and grass-covered.

scenery.name: writing
description: The engraving says: Here lies the mysterious Shadowwolf.  He was decisively executed by mudders when it was discovered he hung out with Knights who say NI.

scenery.name: headstone
description: The headstone is of grey marble.  You might be able to read the writing on it.

rooms.name: The chapel
rooms.description: The %s chapel is solemn and ancient with stained glass windows and dark oak pews.  Most wedding ceremonies are performed here.  Type <help marriage> for information on weddings.

scenery.name: pews
description: Ancient oak seats, darkened by eons of bottoms resting on them.

scenery.name: windows
description: The windows show highlights of mud history, many of them gorey.

scenery.name: ceremony
description: The ceremony is only visible when you scroll back.

rooms.name: the Cleric's Board of Healing
rooms.description:
Clerics post tales of their experiences of this reality here.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: the clerics' church of Praxis
rooms.description: You are in the small cleric's church of Praxis. It is a very simple, yet elegant building. The lack of adornment is made up for in the strong faith you can feel radiating from this little church. People of all faiths come here for prayer, or solitude. The clerics initiate young adventurers here into the class of clerics. <preview> will tell you about becoming a cleric.  There is a passage north.

scenery.name: church
description: It holds a small chapel for wedding ceremonies west, and there is an inner sanctum for clerics north

scenery.name: chapel
description: The clerics of the church perform wedding ceremonies there.

scenery.name: light
description: A blue light protects this place.

scenery.name: passage
description: It leads north into the cleric's inner sanctum.

rooms.name: Voting hall of the clerics
rooms.description: new_long

scenery.name: list
description: During election time, it lists all candidates.

rooms.name: The Chambers of the High Council
rooms.description:
The lights are darkened in this room, a set of 12 candles set along a long, narrow table are the only light.  The table is constructed of the purest black obsidian, and is surrounded at all sides by wooden chairs, each covered in a bright pattern of rubies.  On the walls of the room hang the flags of each of the classes of Nightmare, each created by the best artists in the land.  The ceiling is covered in 4 ornate patterns, each a picture of one of the Head Archwizards of the land.  The pictures give the appearance of watching all that occurs within this chamber.  Sitting on a pedestal made completely of platinum is the Book of Law.  A plaque is attached to the west wall.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: plaque

description: The Book of Law.  Its cover is made of pure solid gold and the pages of the finest leather.  Inside, one can find details of the Laws of the Land.

scenery.name: forlock
description: The Great Enforcer, donning a great black robe lined with a deep red sheath.  The deep stare of Forlock fills you with all that is good and just.

scenery.name: descartes
description: Descartes of Borg, in his most noble position upon a great white horse, is the embodiment of great wisdom and knowlege.

rooms.description:
This is a collection of ill-conceived threats, and useful suggestions intended to increase the orderly flow of information and to decrease the level of inter-player tension (at least for the immortals).

rooms.name: the court of high justice
rooms.description:
The sheer size of this room dazzles you.  The ceiling cannot be viewed
from where you stand.  At one end of the room is a huge chair, in front
of which is a desk.  Both the chair and the desk are made from the finest
wood in the land.  Next to the desk lies a second chair, where witnesses
sit.  On the other side of the room are rows of chairs, and an aisle
through the center.  Two doors lead the way out of this room, north
is the Town Hall, east is the sheriff's office.

scenery.name: gavel

scenery.name: door

scenery.name: office

rooms.name: a small crypt
rooms.description: The altar room is carved from the ancient gray stone that Praxis rests upon. Burning candles along the walls cause the shadows to dance around the room in a chaotic, yet enchanting dance. A large altar rises from the floor in the center of the room and steps carved into the stone lead upwards.

scenery.name: scenes
description: You see Tempos wielding his mighty warhammer in a variety of battles you recognize from your religious studies.

scenery.name: stones
description: The cold grey stone is creased and marked by the tools that were used to carve this room beaneath the earth.

scenery.name: shadows
description: The shadows dance enchantingly across the room in time to the music of the flickering candle flames.

scenery.name: steps
description: The steps are carved into the grey stone and are worn by the passage of many feet over the ages.

scenery.name: walls
description: The walls are hewn roughly from the stone beneath Praxis and are lined with many flickering candles.

scenery.name: candle
description: The candles rest in iron stands set along the wall and are made from animal fat. The candle flames flicker to the tune of the wind, creating the music by which the shadows cavort and dance.

scenery.name: stands
description: The stands are made of black iron and are of plain construction. Each stand holds between three to four lit candles.

rooms.name: the underworld
rooms.description:
This will become something more interesting.  Exit is up.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Praxis dump
rooms.description: The waste of an entire town accumulates here at the Praxis dump.  All around you are mounds upon mounds of trash and other stinking unidentifiable things.  A small alley leads east.

scenery.name: mounds
description: Who knows what might be in amoung that crap?

scenery.name: dump
description: The people of Praxis bring their junk here.

scenery.name: trash
description: Anything and everything.

scenery.name: alley
description: It leads back to Centre Path.

rooms.name: East Boc La south of the monastary
rooms.description: Boc La Road on the eastern side of Praxis is a large dirt road leading towards the center of town, Monument Square. Many footprints have pounded the road into a flat surface, easy to travel. Rusted old lamp posts stand on either side of the road, to light Praxis by night. A small path to the north leads into the village monastary. East Boc La road continues east from here, and the town hall is south.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road is the large path that runs east-west through Praxis.

scenery.name: monastery
description: The monks of Nightmare study and worship there.

scenery.name: square
description: Monument Square is the center point of all of Praxis. Many adventurers enjoying hanging out there, chatting with fellow citizens about life in Praxis.

rooms.name: East Boc La Road
rooms.description: Off to the  east you can see the intersection between Boc La Road and East Road. There are two buildings visible from here, Horace's Supply Store is to the north, and the building housing the adventurer's hall is to the south. People busily bustle back and forth, going about their business.

scenery.name: shop
description: A small place where items can be bought and sold.

scenery.name: road
description: A dirt path leading east and west through Praxis.

scenery.name: area
description: Adventurers gather there to form parties and discuss their adventures.

scenery.name: square
description: You cannot see it very well from here.

scenery.name: people
description: The people walk by at a quicken pace, hardly bothering you with a glance.

scenery.name: hall
description: The hall is where all the adventurer's of Praxis gather to chat.

rooms.name: the east end of Praxis
rooms.description: The dirt path brings you to the end of the village of Praxis. Boc La Road meets up with a smaller dirt path which leads out further east into the wilderness. The path is very narrow and looks unsafe. After travelling a couple of meters it is suddenly engulfed in a mass of green leaves and undergrowth. Up ahead, you can see the darker path of East road, leading to Praxis' cemetery. West takes you back along East Boc La road.

scenery.name: road
description: It leads west toward the village center.

scenery.name: village
description: Praxis is a small adventuring community of the Nightmare reality.

scenery.name: wilderness
description: Stories tell of bandits and rogues out in the wilderness.

scenery.name: path
description: The path leads in many directions from here, towards the Praxis cemetery, the wilderness, and back towards Monument Square.

scenery.name: cemetery
description: The Praxis cemetery is off to the north on East Road.

rooms.name: the southern end of East Road
rooms.description: Starting your journey down East Road, you can see that this is a less travelled street. Boc La Road is south from here, running straight through Praxis. Every now and then you can see a street lamp or two, in its ancient and rusted stage. The walls of the supply store border the western side of the road, and the Praxis Library, one of the biggest libraries in this realm, is to the east.

scenery.name: road
description: East Road, which marks the far east end of Praxis.

scenery.name: roads
description: East Road and Boc La Road.

scenery.name: side
description: It's the supply shop.

scenery.name: shop

scenery.name: walls
description: They are nothing special.

scenery.name: wall
description: You are fairly certain that you cannot climb them.

scenery.name: library
description: It is open for your reading pleasure.

rooms.description: Sun Alley, named for its' beautiful view of the sunsets, shoots off west from East Road. East Road continues, heading north and south upon the eastern border of town. To the east, you can see the Praxis cemetery, shaded by large trees. The air is very still here, and a feeling of foreboding hangs in the air.

scenery.name: alley
description: A bright and cheery alley which marks the northern boarder of Praxis.

scenery.name: road

scenery.name: cemetery

scenery.name: trees

scenery.name: forest

rooms.name: the north end of East Road
rooms.description: East Road comes to a sudden dead end as you find yourself at the foot of Praxis forest. These outskirts of Praxis aren't visited very often. The area is very quiet and lonely with so few people around.  Ahead, at the end of the road you can see a  discreet sign tacked to a tree. A  small footpath leads off the road in an eastern direction.

rooms.description: The area which you have wandered into is the farmlands of Praxis. Large cornfields surround you, stretching for miles to both the east and the west. The stalks grow strong and tall, making it hard to see. Off in the far distance you can see the speck of what appears to be a farmhouse.

scenery.name: stalk

scenery.name: corn

rooms.description:
The Fighters of our reality post tales of their glorious adventures here, as well as info on the dangers out there.

rooms.description: The Hall of Fighters is decorated with ornate tapestries of men and women engaged in combat of all traditions.  Adventuring fighters are gathered around discussing glory at the base of a spiraling staircase which leads up through a magically lit hole in the ceiling.  Young warriors stand about hoping to learn the ways of the fighter.  Children may <preview> what it is like to be a fighter.

rooms.description: You are in a huge forest just north of the village of Praxis.  The forest extends in all directions, with a small path leading deeper into the forest north and into one of the main village roads south.

scenery.name: path
description: A small path throught the huge North Forest.

scenery.name: forest

scenery.name: village

rooms.description: The small footpath is leading you further and further into the depths of North Forest. The forest becomes much denser, and the the trees indicate that this is the older section of the forest. The foliage is so dense, that little light can filter through. North leads further into the forest, and south takes you back towards the main village. East you can see another path heading off.

rooms.name: a dirt highway
rooms.description: You find yourself on a large dirt highway which heads west out of Praxis. In the distance the Daroq Mountains rise majestically over the flat plains of the rest of the lands. This area is rather sparse, with just a small smattering of trees. There appears to have been grass here a long time ago, but it has been ruined from the many adventurers that traverse these parts. East leads to West Boc La road and east takes you to the highway

scenery.name: highway
description: A highway linking Praxis to the western lands of Nightmare.

scenery.name: trees
description: The trees are very small. This isn't a very good environment for them to grow in.

scenery.name: village
description: A tiny adventuring village. They have many services there.

scenery.name: mountains
description: The Daroq Mountains are far to the west.

rooms.name: the great western highway
rooms.description: The Great Western Highway, extending both east and west, allows travel between the mountains and the many other villages of this land. The further west you travel, more dry and arid the air becomes. The highway has become very dusty, and starting to blend in with the rest of the earth, making the path almost indistinguishable. Looking beyond the Daraq mountains you can see the beginnings of the Qajip Desert.

scenery.name: highway
description: A well-traveled dirt road between the mountains in the west and the populated towns of the east.

scenery.name: lands
description: You are in a forested valley with the Daroq Mountains in the west.

scenery.name: mountains
description: The Daroq Mountains, home of vile goblins.

scenery.name: mountain
description: Trendahl Mountain.

scenery.name: daroq mountains
description: Evil goblins live in the tunnels that thread the mountains.

rooms.name: the western highway in the shadows of the Daroq Mountains
rooms.description: The Daroq Mountains tower above you to the west, blocking out the sky so much that an eerie twilight covers the land.  There is a small overgrown path to the south heading towards some rather ominous-looking peaks in the distance.  The Great Western Highway, which provides a route of travel east, ends just west of here in a mountain pass.  There is only a small break in the forest that surrounds you to the north.

scenery.name: peaks
description: The peaks you see are the twin peaks of the Destiny Mountains.

scenery.name: path
description:
The path is very overgrown and seems to go in the direction of the peaks in
the distance.

rooms.description: This is the High Mortals board of wisdom. It is used for the High Mortals to discuss issues concerning the welfare of the mud.

You are in a deep hole in the ground. The light is very poor down here.

rooms.name: the hospital of Praxis
rooms.description: You are in the hospital of Praxis. It basically consists of one large single room, with several crude beds placed in rows. The hospital doesn't look to be to clean, you might want to think twice before engaging their services. A list of all the services that can be performed is posted on the far wall. The exit back to the main road is east.

scenery.name: list
description: You can read all the services by typing <read list>.

scenery.name: hospital
description: The clerics here specialize in regenerating lost limbs.

scenery.name: clerics
description: They are mending the wounds of patients.

scenery.name: cleric
description: He is mending a patient's wounds.

rooms.name: the Nightmare Inn
rooms.description: You find yourself at the entrance of the most prestigious inn in Nightmare. The floor is carpeted with plush red carpet, and the walls are trimmed with golden paint. Large oaken doors from where you entered stand behind you, and directly in front of you the front desk of the hotel stands. Type list to see the available rooms, and <rent 'type'> to rent a certain type of room.

npcs.name: a hotel key

scenery.name: entrance
description: The lobby of the hotel is very large and spacious. It looks like it is a rather expensive hotel.

scenery.name: floor

scenery.name: carpet
description: The carpet is in good shape, although it is a bit worn in spots. There is a golden symbol of the hotel standing in the center of it.

scenery.name: wall
description: The walls have been painted white with some gold trim on all the edges.

scenery.name: doors

scenery.name: desk

scenery.name: hotel

scenery.name: thatch

scenery.name: house

rooms.description:
Welcome to Horace's Adventurer's Supply Shop!
Horace buys and sells goods created for and found by adventurer's when he is in.  The store opens out onto Boc La Road south.  There is a passage to the north guarded by a magic field.

scenery.name: shop

scenery.name: passage

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road.

rooms.description:
Welcome to the hall of immortals!
High mortals come here to seek mentors who will guide them into the world of immortality.  Mortals come here to prove their worthiness for high mortalhood.  A spiral flight of stairs leads up out of the cellar.

npcs.name: Unity, the grantor of immortality
description: Unity grants immortality to those high mortals with mentors to sponsor them.
npcs.room_description: Unity, the grantor of immortality is here.

rooms.description: You have entered one of the sleeping chambers of the posh Nightmare Inn. The room is in perfect order. A large bed sits in the middle of the room, surrounded by night stands on both side. A crystal lamp rests the nightstand on the right. The carpet is a lovely shade of sand, and the furniture is a deep oaken color. In order to exit the room, try 'leave'.

rooms.name: Praxis post office

Welcome to the Praxis Post Office!
The Praxis post office is a quaint whitewashed building. The floor is a worn wood, due to all the customers that walk upon its floors. Red trim lines the walls, and a window in the far corner lets in a slight breeze. People come here to read and post mail.  Type <mail> to access your mailbox, or <mail name> to send mail to player name.  The Nightmare post office runs on the intermud system, meaning that you can send mails to players on any other mud on the system.  Type <muds> to find out who is on the system.  The groups available can be accessed by typing <g> at the % prompt.

rooms.name: the plate of Atmos
rooms.description:
A beautifully crafted, fake-silver plate armour once owned by Atmos the Geek.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: colours
description: Mostly puce.

scenery.name: office
description: A nice little space with a desk in it.

rooms.name: Last Dragon Restaurant
rooms.description:
Welcome to the Last Dragon Restaurant!
The Last Dragon Restaurant is home to the finest cusine in Praxis! The atmosphere is lively and friendly, as is the service. The restaurant itself is an oaken structure, well polished and maintained. A menu is displayed on the wall, and the waitress will be happy to serve you when she is arround. South of here runs Sun Alley.

scenery.name: restaurant
description: The Last Dragon Restaurant, home of great Praxian cuisine.

scenery.name: wall
description: The menu is posted there.

scenery.name: menu
description: You may read it if you like.

rooms.name: Rogue's Board of Fiendish Plots
rooms.description:
On this rotting wood board, rogues come to post of bounties dastardly deeds, and other fiendish foils for other rogues to see.
A marked archway down returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Rogue Hut
rooms.description: You have stumbled upon the hideout of the Nightmare rogues. What appears to be a worn down shack on the outside is actually a well put together fortress on the inside.  A magic blue light guards the entrance to the heart of the fortress down a flight of stairs.  The Grand Master Rogue waits here to initiate new slime into the vile and contemptable class of rogues. <preview> will tell you about becoming a rogue.

scenery.name: hideout
description: Rogues come here to plot wicked acts.

scenery.name: shack
description: It is not really a shack, but a fortress.

scenery.name: fortress
description: The rogues make this place their hideout.

scenery.name: light
description: Only rogues can pass beyond it.

scenery.name: stairs
description: They lead down into the heart of the rogue hideout.

scenery.name: rogue
description: He initiates new rogues.

rooms.name: Voting hall of the rogues
rooms.description: new_long

scenery.name: list
description: During election time, it lists all candidates.

rooms.name: among the roots of the tree
rooms.description: Here, among the huge, stalactite-like roots of the fabled mages' tree, a large room has been excavated. All moisture is magically funneled to the roots, so the air here is very dry. Apart from the tree itself (and the occasional mage), no life dares intrude upon the silence of this place. In the center of this room, a small pedestral juts up from the ground, while, Close to the north wall, a donations box reminds you of your financial responsibility to your class. A small stairway to the east leads up into the heart of the mage tree.

scenery.name: tree
description: You are among the roots of the tree.

scenery.name: north wall
description: Near the north wall of the tree there's a donation box

scenery.name: wall
description: Near the north wall of the tree there's a donation box

scenery.name: roots
description: These enormous roots supply nourishment for the immense mage tree. According to legend, the roots reach the very core of the world, effectively making the mage tree as permanent as the Earth.

scenery.name: stairway
description: The stairway has been carved out of the roots.  It seems unsturdy, but as soon as you step on it you are reassured, for the stairway partakes of the infinite stability of the tree itself.

rooms.name: Centre Path outside Lars' Pub
rooms.description: Centre Path leads through the heart of the business district of Praxis, and down towards the famous Port of Praxis. Rowdy customers can be seen heading west towards Lar's Pub. The building is very old and worn. The abuse of many drunken adventurer's has began to take its toll on the establishment.

scenery.name: path
description: Centre Path leads to Monument Square south and out of town north.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road is the main east-west road.

scenery.name: pub
description: Lars Pub, now mostly obsolete, but it is the original.

scenery.name: square
description: The central square of Praxis.

rooms.name: Centre Path just south of Krasna Square
rooms.description: A small alley crosses Centre Path here just south of Krasna Square.  As it winds on south, Centre Path travels through the business center of South Praxis up to the Port of Praxis.

scenery.name: path
description: Centre Path leads to Monument Square north and to the port south.

scenery.name: alley
description: It opens up to a yard of houses east, and a post and bank west.

rooms.name: Southern Praxis
rooms.description: Southern Praxis is the business district of this small adventuring community.  Through it runs Centre Path, bringing people from the centre of town through here and to the southwest the area really begins to rumble with horse and foot traffic.

scenery.name: path
description: The main road leading north and south through Praxis.

scenery.name: port
description: You cannot see that from here.

scenery.name: road
description: It leads out of town.

rooms.name: Praxis Commercial District
rooms.description: Centre Path leads south into the bustling Port of Praxis where it dead ends at Pier 1.  Business life hurries all about you to get things done before the end of teh short Praxis day.  In the realty high mortals make transactions for real estate with the mighty Atmos.  In the great Hall of Fighters northwest fighters gather both night and day.  Praxis centre is northeast from here.

scenery.name: path
description: It is the main road winding north and south through Praxis.

scenery.name: pier
description: Everything that comes into Praxis from overseas comes through here.

scenery.name: hall
description: The fighters of this reality often come from all over to gather there.

scenery.name: realty
description: High mortals by stuff to build castles with there.

scenery.name: fighters
description: They are roaming aimlessly about the Hall of Fighters.

scenery.name: people
description: They are going about their business in the area.

scenery.name: high mortals
description: The mightiest of mortals who often comprise class leaders.

rooms.name: A disgusting sewer
rooms.description: These sewers under Praxis are filled with slime.

scenery.name: sewers
description: The disgusting tunnels of human waste under Praxis.

scenery.name: slime
description: Nasty, nasty.

scenery.name: wall
description: A disgusting slime-coated wall.

scenery.name: ceiling
description: A disgusting slime-coated ceiling.

rooms.name: The Praxis sewers
rooms.description: You are underneath the town of Praxis inside their small sewer system.  There is a manhole to the surface above you.

scenery.name: manhole
description: It is a hole that leads to the surface.

rooms.name: a large, bloodstained pole
rooms.description:
a large, bloodstained pole.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: desk
description: A rickety wooden desk hardly ever used, as the sheriff never does seem to be able to sit for any period of time.

scenery.name: building
description: A wooden building constructed long ago for a lawless era.  There is a jail cell in one area.

scenery.name: area
description: A jail cell.

scenery.name: exits
description: Boc La Road and Centre Path.

rooms.name: Pit of Spiders
rooms.description:
You find yourself in the dreaded pit of spiders.  The ground and walls surrounding you are completely smooth, except for the crawling lumps of deadly spiders.  By the looks of it, your worst fears crawling lumps of deadly spiders.  By the looks of it, your worst fears have come true: there is no escape.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

npcs.name: Praxis cave spider
description: A medium-sized black spider with a cresent-shaped moon on its tail end.

scenery.name: spiders
description: Greusome spiders, both dead and alive, completely cover the ground and walls of the pit.

scenery.name: wall
description: More spiders.

rooms.name: Monument Square
rooms.description:
You are in Monument Square, once known as Krasna Square. The two main roads of Praxis intersect here, where all of Nightmare's people gather in joy and sorrow.  The road running north and south is called Centre Path, while Boc La Road is the name of the road running east and west.
There is a sign here you can read.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road leads east toward the adventurer's hall and the Praxis Monastary.

scenery.name: path
description: Centre Road leads south toward the bank and post office.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign you can read.

scenery.name: square
description: Krasna Square is the central point of Praxis.

rooms.name: Monastary stairwell
rooms.description: A spiraling flight of stairs leads up to the monastery attic and down to the cellar.  The prayer area is west.

scenery.name: stairs
description: They spiral up and down in this old monastery.

rooms.name: Adventurer's Supply Storage Room
rooms.description:
Horace stores weapons and such here.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Sun Alley near Centre Path
rooms.description: Sun Alley is a bright path, named for the fact that the sun always seems to be shining down upon it. The path is fairly quiet, except for the occasional villager that is out strolling or running their errands. The alley runs north of the village, and interescts Centre Path west of here. To the south you can see a small brown thatch house.

scenery.name: alley
description: It is bright and cheerful, not like that alley on the south end.

scenery.name: path
description: The main north-south road of Praxis.

scenery.name: intersection
description: Sun alley meets Centre Path there.

scenery.name: house
description: It's a small thatch house, nothing special.

rooms.name: Sun Alley near East Road
rooms.description: South of here, at the corner of this sunny alley is the Last Dragon Restaurant. The building is a brownish grey wooden structure with very little adornment on the outside. East Road interesects with this alley over to the east. The beginnings of a forest indicate the borders of Praxis here.

scenery.name: foo
description: Whatever you say.

scenery.name: alley
description: This alley is the northernmost part of Praxis. Only the great North Forest is north of here.

scenery.name: restaurant
description: A great place to rest up from adventuring.

scenery.name: road
description: East Road.

scenery.name: forest
description: The huge forest north of Praxis.  The walled town of Cartesia is out there somewhere.

scenery.name: border
description: The forest keeps Praxis from expanding any further north.

rooms.name: Horace's general supply shop
rooms.description:
Welcome to Horace's General Supply Shop!
Horace's supply shop is the largest business running in Praxis to date. It was established long ago, and has earned itself a very high reputation over the years. A long counter stands at the back of the store, where you can often see Horace himself standing, bargaining with customers. Two windows frame the front wall of the store, and a cheery red door exits you back out to the main street. Horace buys and sells goods created for and found by adventurer's when he is in. The pasasge north is guarded by a magic field.

scenery.name: shop
description: You can buy and sell things here.

scenery.name: passage
description: Horace keeps the things he has for sale back there.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road.

rooms.name: Horace's General Supply Shop
rooms.description:
Welcome to Horace's General Supply Shop!
Horace buys and sells goods created for and found by adventurer's when he is in.  The store opens out onto Boc La Road south.  There is a passage to the north guarded by a magic field.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: shop
description: You can buy and sell things here.

scenery.name: passage
description: Horace keeps the things he has for sale back there.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road.

rooms.name: Torture Room
rooms.description:
You are in the infamous Torture hall, a small room used by the Praxis Guard on only the worst of criminals.  From your vantage point upon a table in the center of the room, you are unable to gather much information about your surroundings.  However, you can see various devices scattered around the room, covered with dust and cobwebs.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: devices
description: Assorted mechanical devices used in the performing cruel and unusual punishments.

scenery.name: table
description: An uncomfortable cement table.

rooms.name: Praxis Town Hall
rooms.description: This is a large stately hall; the walls are covered with rich hangings, the vaulted roof is supported by thick marble columns.  A wide curving staircase leads up to the council chambers above.  The exit to the street is north.

scenery.name: hall
description: It is five times the height of a tall man.

scenery.name: roof
description: If you "listen to council", perhaps you will hear them.

scenery.name: hangings
description: They depict the noble self-sacrifice of being a councilor.

scenery.name: columns
description: They have gargoyles at their tops.

scenery.name: staircase
description: It goes between two of the columns.

scenery.name: chambers
description: If you listen, perhaps you can hear the council.

scenery.name: court
description: This is where trials are held.

scenery.name: street
description: It is Boc La Road south of the monastary.

scenery.name: gargoyles
description: They look innocently inanimate.

scenery.name: gargoyle
description: It is impenetrateable as a stone wall.

rooms.name: the upper trunk
rooms.description: A very large room has been carved out of the upper trunk of the mage tree. A small stairway leads down to the entrance of the tree, while upwards it leads out of the tree, and into the wide canopy of the branches.

scenery.name: mage tree
description: You cannot see the tree for the living wooden walls surrounding you.

scenery.name: upper trunk
description: You are in the trunk of the tree.

scenery.name: entrance
description: The entrance is in the room below you.

scenery.name: canopy
description: Above you are leafy green branches. Go up into them.

scenery.name: trunk
description: You are in the trunk of the tree.

scenery.name: tree
description: You cannot see the tree for the living wooden walls surrounding you.

scenery.name: branches
description: Above you are leafy green branches. Go up into them.

scenery.name: walls
description: This room has walls. Fancy that. They're made of wood, which makes sense since you are inside of a tree.

scenery.name: stairway
description: The wooden stairway creaks and groans as you put your weight on it.

rooms.name: Outside the financial district
rooms.description: Leading out east into the rural lands outside of Praxis, this unnamed dirt road sits almost entirely untravelled.  The business district of Praxis is west.

scenery.name: road
description: It is temporarily blocked going east.

rooms.name: the void
rooms.description:
The void.  Go down to get out.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: West Boc La in Praxis
rooms.description: The local pub on the southwest corner of the square east of here gets little business at the height of the day.  As twilight fall into dusk, however, you will notice more people making their way into the pub to cap off a day of adventure.  The road you are on, West Boc La, leads into the western districts of Praxis and east to the centre of town.

scenery.name: church
description: It looks like the entrance might be on the road leading north from Monument Square.

scenery.name: lamps
description: All of the street lamps along the road provide minimal light at night.

scenery.name: pub
description: Local adventurers wind down their day in Lars' Pub.

scenery.name: road
description: It goes beyond the western districts of Praxis into the mountains.

scenery.name: square
description: At the centre of Praxis, it is where Boc La and Centre Path meet.

rooms.name: West Boc La
rooms.description: Western Praxis is a more rural district of town.  The southern area opens up into farmlands while the northern side is lined with small huts and houses. The road continues to run in an east-west direction.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road runs east and west through Praxis.

scenery.name: roads
description: West Road and Boc La Road.

scenery.name: highway
description: A very heavily travelled highway to the western lands of Nightmare. Beware of the Daroq Mountains.

scenery.name: mountains
description: The Daroq Mountains.  Vile creatures are rumoured to live in and about them.

scenery.name: house
description: This tiny little house has wisps of white smoke coming out of the door and windows.

scenery.name: smoke
description: Lacey wisps of white smoke are coming out of the house to the north.

rooms.name: The western outskirts of Praxis
rooms.description: Beyond Praxis to the west tower the wicked Daroq Mountains which protect this part of reality from the punishing Qajip Desert.  Boc La Road of a local village leads east into the centre of the town.  West Road travels north from here.

scenery.name: road
description: Boc La Road runs east and west through Praxis.

scenery.name: roads
description: West Road and Boc La Road.

scenery.name: highway
description: A very heavily travelled highway to the western lands of Nightmare. Beware of the Daroq Mountains.

scenery.name: mountains
description: The Daroq Mountains.  Vile creatures are rumoured to live in and about them.

rooms.name: a graffitti covered wall
rooms.description: You are in among ruined buildings in a bad part of the village.  There is graffiti all over the wall to the east.

scenery.name: buildings
description: They are worn down by years of neglect.

scenery.name: graffiti
description: Some is fresh, some is old.

scenery.name: wall
description:
You can scribble something on it.  <scribble stuff>.
You can also read what is on it.

rooms.name: the southern end of West Road
rooms.description: West Road is the main residential road that runs through Praxis. One or two more houses lie on either side of the road, until it comes to a dead end south of here at Boc La Road. The small huts lining the road are rather run down and unattractive. You can hear noises coming from inside of them, as the inhabitants carry on with their lives.

scenery.name: road
description: West Road, which marks the westernmost end of Praxis.

scenery.name: huts
description: They are small peasant huts.

scenery.name: hut
description: It has a thatch roofing, and is not really extravagant.

rooms.name: along West Road
rooms.description: You are in the middle of West Road where rural huts line the sides of the road.  One of the huts on the east side has a sign hanging outside it.  A mound of loose dirt covers part of the west side of the road.

scenery.name: road
description: There is a mound of loose dirt piled by its side.

scenery.name: dirt
description: It is very loose.

scenery.name: hut
description: It looks very mystical.

scenery.name: sign
description: Those who can read are very fortunate indeed!

rooms.name: the north end of West Road
rooms.description: West Road comes to an abrupt end as it is engulfed by the forest to the north. A huge ancient willow tree provides shelter to this entire section of the road. At its massive roots you can see a whole leading down into the depths of the earth. Boc La Road lies far south of here.

scenery.name: tree
description: It must be older than Praxis itself.

scenery.name: hole
description: You might even be able to enter the tree.

scenery.name: road
description: This end of the road is shaded by the huge tree of mysterious origins.

scenery.name: foo
description: You're daft.

scenery.name: bar
description: Had to check that too, eh?

rooms.name: The wilderness outside of Praxis
rooms.description: The vegetation in the area outside the village thickens into jungle as you head east.

scenery.name: jungle
description: A wilderness area full of outlaws and mysterious things.

scenery.name: village
description: The adventurer's town of Praxis.

scenery.name: vegetation
description: It gets thicker to the east.

rooms.name: The tropical wilderness
rooms.description: You are inside a jungle that thickens along the path northeast.  The path widens west as it heads towards the adventuring village of Praxis.

scenery.name: jungle
description: A wilderness area full of outlaws and mysterious things.

scenery.name: village
description: The adventurer's town of Praxis.

scenery.name: vegetation
description: It gets thicker to the east.

scenery.name: path
description: You can see it opening up towards the village west.

rooms.name: A small yard
rooms.description: Daytime makes this beautiful yard at the end of a small alley glow with peace. Quaint houses surround the yard on all flanks except to the west where the alley intersects Centre Path. There is a manhole where the alley meets the yard.

npcs.name: A poor beggar
description: He is a poor beggar looking only for a few coins.

scenery.name: alley
description: It looks beautiful here.

scenery.name: lamp
description: Dimly illuminated lights.
